name: codex-peer
description: Delegate to Codex or subscription-authenticated Gemini and receive a saved completion notification.

interface.shortDescription: CodexとGeminiへの依頼と完了通知
interface.longDescription: MacとWindowsのCodex、公式Antigravity CLIのGemini 3.8 Flashへ依頼し、結果保存後の通知で回収します。親AIによる定期監視は不要です。
defaultPrompt: Ask a peer Codex to inspect its local environment and notify me when it finishes.
Ask Gemini 3.8 Flash to work in an isolated workspace.
Read the saved result from a peer completion notification.
